{{Quote|People all over the Galaxy have built harvesters to mine minerals, collect gasses, water, etc. This type of mass production will only lead to societal breakdown in years to come. Now is our chance to slow the advancement of strife.|Snugli Explevey, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:MR" />}}
'''Snugli Explevey''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Meatlumps|Meatlump]] criminal who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he operated out of the [[Meatlump Hideout]] in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]].<ref name="SWG:MR" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Snugli Explevey, a technology-hating Meatlump, grew distraught over the large number of harvesting machines sprouting throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. To combat what he perceived to be a threat to society, he gave a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] a [[Camera/Legends|film camera]] to take pictures of harvesters on a number of [[Planet/Legends|worlds]], namely: Corellia, [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], [[Lok/Legends|Lok]], [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], [[Rori/Legends|Rori]], [[Talus/Legends|Talus]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. Using the information taken from the pictures, the Meatlumps would be able to locate future targets.<ref name="SWG:MR" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateMeatlumpHideoutMale.jpg|250px|thumb|Every possible depiction of Snugli Explevey]]
Snugli Explevey was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:MR" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]]. Snugli Explevey was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Meatlumps Theme Park|Meatlumps Theme Park]]," introduced with "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 10|Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King]]," released on [[June 19]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67812&month=062008|text=Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King}}</ref>

During each server reset, Explevey's appearance was randomized, but he consistently appeared as a Human male.<ref name="SWG:MR" />
